title: Lions Club Eyeglass Collection Drive
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content:
LIONS 

CLUB 

EYEGLASS 

COLLECTION

LIONS CLUB EYEGLASS COLLECTION

The Oxford Lions Club Sight Saving Committee is collecting used eyeglasses, sunglasses as well as cases! These glasses and cases are donated all over the world to children who are in need. The lenses and frames from the donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's eye needs. Every year, Oxford Lions Club collects and sends 900-plus pairs of glasses to children in need!Please send any glasses donations to Betsy Beaton (Marshall Elementary School) or Shaunna Tafelski (Board Office) by mid-May We are happy to swing by and pick up glasses donations or they can be dropped off at Marshall or the Board Office. Thank you for supporting the Oxford Lions Club! Thanks!

summary: The **Oxford Lions Club** is collecting **used eyeglasses, sunglasses, and cases** to donate to children in need worldwide. The donated glasses are modified to meet individual children's vision needs, with the Lions Club sending over **900 pairs annually**. Donations should be sent to **Betsy Beaton at Marshall Elementary School** or **Shaunna Tafelski at the Board Office by mid-May**. Pick-up or drop-off available at Marshall Elementary or the Board Office.

title: Teen Mental Health Research Study Opportunity
source_title: Talawanda High School | Smore Newsletters for Education

blocks.content: Register here

summary: Miami University is conducting a **Teenager Emotion Disclosure Study** for students in grades 9-12. The study examines how teens talk to caregivers about mental health through a **confidential 1-hour online survey**. Participants receive **$15** for their time. Parent/guardian consent is required. To register or ask questions, contact lead researcher Noelle Marousis at **framlab@miamioh.edu**. Study approved by Miami University's IRB (#02456r).
